title: A sent-back no-spec change can declare that it changes specs
description: A sent-back no-spec change can declare that it changes specs
acceptance_criteria: a no-spec change, approved and then sent back, answers no_spec_change no, adds a delta and is approved, materialized and verified with the delta applied; no_spec_change yes, no on a change that already changes specs, and any answer on an approved change are refused

answers.constraints: answers stay draft-only; the send-back route for re-scoping is reused unchanged; a rationale is still recorded only by change new
